question.problem: Determine if the vector $u$ lies on the plane $Π:r=sb+tc,$ $t,s\in R$, where  $b=⟨1,5,8⟩$, $c=⟨-1,-1,-3⟩$, and  $u=⟨-3,5,-7⟩.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of $s\cdot t$ from the decomposition $u=sb+tc.$
question.worked_solution:
By definition, $u\in Π$ if there exist $t$ and $s$ such that

$$
\begin{aligned}sb+tc & =u \\ s[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 5 \\ 8\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -1 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 5 \\ -7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s-t=-3 \\ 5s-t=5 \\ 8s-3t=-7\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 \\ 5 & -1 & 5 \\ 8 & -3 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & 20 \\ 8 & -3 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-8{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & 20 \\ 0 & 5 & 17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 5 & 17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & -8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The third row of the augmented matrix now corresponds to the equation $0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}=-8,$ which has no solution.

So, there are no values of $s$ and $t$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}sb+tc=u.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that $u$ does *not* lie on the plane $Π.$
